title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. We need to determine if $$f(x)=-x$$ can fit the data in the scatterplot.

title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: Observe the trend in the scatterplot. Does the data appear to follow a linear, quadratic, or some other pattern?

title: Effect of $$f(x)=-x$$
text: If $$f(x)=-x$$, then the term $$f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$ becomes $$-x_i \beta_2$$. Consider how this affects the linearity of the model.

title: Checking Linearity
text: Does the function $$f(x)=-x$$ allow the model to remain linear with respect to the parameters?
